warnings: Sample calculations are not engineering deliverables
Detailed isometric visual is a rendered 2D asset, not a real-time 3D mesh
TCVN metadata/status checked on 2026-11-15; verify against VSQI before design/acceptance.
Android stable release signing requires four GitHub Secrets; previous debug APK signing cannot be migrated automatically
Local approvals have no identity verification and are not legally binding
API keys may be encrypted on device with user passphrase; no server secret vault active
No server-side synchronization or access control in offline mode
V5.9/V6.0 metadata is a signed Google Drive event ledger, not a PostgreSQL deployment.
Legacy localStorage/IndexedDB documents are not auto-uploaded; Admin may explicitly import metadata backup after review.
The new Streamlit shared-workspace feature still needs live two-account and 500 MB acceptance testing.
Signed Drive event metadata is limited to 2500 events and lacks SQL transactional concurrency.
V6.0.1 can show 500 files in the inline table; native dialog offers full inventory/CSV to 3000 files per project.
Legacy Drive uploads have unknown individual uploader identity until registered through the authenticated app.
Live two-account browser acceptance and 500 MB upload testing not completed for V6.0.1.
